Research Bazaar Victoria

Nov 26-28 2024

About ResBaz Victoria

A festival of digital research

Led by Monash eResearch, ResBaz will be held on November 26-28, 2024 at the Clayton campus. Join us for an engaging, in-person event that emphasises participation and collaboration!

The Research Bazaar is a dynamic forum designed to empower researchers with cutting-edge digital research tools and skills. Sessions at this year's ResBaz will offer a brief practical introduction to a broad selection of topics and tools related to digital research practice relevant across multiple disciplines.

We welcome researchers from ALL over Australia, at ALL levels, and from ALL disciplines! Whether you're a PhD candidate, a research master's student, an early career researcher, or a research technologist or software engineer supporting research, this event is for you.



ResBaz Vic 2024 registration is now open!
Check the confirmed sessions and register to secure your spot.
